summary: RENEWAL_GUIDANCE uses local disk only, has no gather step and reads the controller HostMetric table directly: set SHIP_TARGET=controller_db, REPORT_TYPE=RENEWAL_GUIDANCE and SHIP_PATH, then run build_report.
questions: How do I run the RENEWAL_GUIDANCE report?
Does RENEWAL_GUIDANCE need a gather step?

answer_card.title: Run the RENEWAL_GUIDANCE report
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
export METRICS_UTILITY_SHIP_TARGET=controller_db
export METRICS_UTILITY_REPORT_TYPE=RENEWAL_GUIDANCE
export METRICS_UTILITY_SHIP_PATH=/path_to_built_report/
metrics-utility build_report --since=12months --ephemeral=1month
```
No gather step; reads the HostMetric table. Local disk storage only.
